Mac Macaroni & Cheese
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:31am

Ingredients




1 (8 oz.) Velveeta
2 teaspoons butter
1/4 cup flour
2 cups milk
8 ounces macaroni

Preparation

1 Boil macaroni 8-10 minutes. Meanwhile, melt butter in microwave. Stir in flour. Add milk and microwave 3 minutes. Add half the Velveeta, microwave another 2-3 minutes. Add remaining cheese, continue to microwave until melted, stir each 1-2 minutes. Put macaroni in casserole dish, add cheese mixture, bake 20-25 minutes. Enjoy gooey baked macaroni and cheese.
